scope: Official source chronology for representative model selections in the Codex desktop interface archive

policy.selection: Represent a paid ChatGPT Codex user adopting the contemporary general-purpose workhorse, retaining Sol across GPT-5.6, GPT-6 and GPT-6.1. This is not a universal desktop-default history.
policy.dateConvention: Source dates have day precision. A UI boundary at midnight UTC is a rendering convention, not an observed rollout timestamp.
policy.reasoningEffort: Preserve the existing medium sample setting where supported; this research does not establish every historical default reasoning effort.
policy.fixtureAuth: The early GPT-5.3-Codex launch was ChatGPT-authenticated, not API-key general availability. Fixtures should be described as a reconstruction and not an observed authenticated historical session.
policy.aboutText: Model labels are a historical reconstruction. Official rollout dates and bundled model catalogs inform the selection; where a desktop default cannot be verified, the timeline uses a contemporary representative model. Saved preferences, account access and server rollouts may differ.
